title: Why Is the Middle Still Cold? #microwave #science
description:
Microwaves don't cook from the inside out. Most of their power is gone 1–2 cm into the food, so only a thin outer layer heats directly and the middle waits for slow conduction.

Full video: Why microwaves don't heat food from the inside → https://youtu.be/ri17BZl0Iq8

Sources
- Püschner GmbH, Penetration depths of microwaves at 2450 MHz
- HyperPhysics (Georgia State University), Microwave ovens
- Chaplin, Water structure and science: dielectric properties of water (London South Bank University)
- USDA FSIS, Cooking with microwave ovens
- Wikipedia, Microwave oven
